project_info.theme: Toyota Veloz Cross as a smart wingman with Safety Sense
project_info.color_palette: Charcoal, orange, sky blue, white, road gray

main_subject.detail: An interior-feature poster showing the blue elephant mascot driving inside a Toyota Veloz Cross. The windshield becomes a tech-overlay explaining Toyota Safety Sense features on a coastal road: 'He thong canh bao tien va cham (PCS)', 'Den chieu xa tu dong (AHB)', and 'He thong canh bao lech lan duong (LDA)'. A Toyota Safety Sense badge appears near the windshield. The center screen displays a parking or surround-camera view. Large text reads 'TOYOTA VELOZ CROSS LA CHAN THONG MINH TRU COT Vo lo'. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Playful ADAS education poster with mascot-driven interior view, real dashboard detail, and illustrated safety overlays

composition_elements.text: Toyota Safety Sense / He thong canh bao tien va cham (PCS) / Den chieu xa tu dong (AHB) / He thong canh bao lech lan duong (LDA) / TOYOTA VELOZ CROSS / LA CHAN THONG MINH / TRU COT / Vo lo / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota Safety Sense badge near the windshield and road-sensor overlay
Top Right: Toyota logo over the interior roofline and mountain-road view
Bottom Left: Blue elephant mascot in driver's seat and handwritten 'Move your world'
Bottom Right: Large white-and-orange slogan block with the handwritten 'Vo lo'
Center/Background: Real Toyota Veloz Cross dashboard and windshield overlaid with lane, car, and radar safety graphics on a coastal road

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Crisp dashboard visibility, vivid overlay graphics, playful mascot energy with realistic cabin detail

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal interior-feature campaign with UI-style ADAS overlays

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Toyota Veloz Cross safety-feature education. Centerpiece is a real Toyota Veloz Cross interior seen from the back seat, with a blue elephant mascot driving while the windshield is overlaid with Toyota Safety Sense graphics showing PCS, AHB, and LDA on a coastal road. Background is the actual cabin, dashboard, center display, and mountain-sea road beyond the windshield. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, Toyota Safety Sense badge, exact feature labels, and the slogan 'TOYOTA VELOZ CROSS LA CHAN THONG MINH TRU COT Vo lo', plus the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal interior-feature campaign with UI-style ADAS overlays, bright interior-tech commercial lighting, crisp dashboard detail and vivid safety graphics, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
